note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for an MMSegmentation UPerNet with ResNet-50 backbone including norm_cfg, data_preprocessor, backbone, decode_head, and auxiliary_head as nested dicts.
summarize_model_config: summarize the UPerNet ResNet50 model configuration dict including backbone, decode_head, and auxiliary_head settings
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration dict used across backbone and heads
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor configuration with ImageNet mean/std normalization settings
review_decode_head: review the UPerHead decode head configuration with pyramid pooling scales and 19 classes
review_auxiliary_head: review the FCNHead auxiliary head configuration with cross entropy loss weight 0.4
